exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "To become a noun".

options.text: Noun に なる
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Noun に なる matches "To become a noun".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Noun に なる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses changing into a new state, status, or condition using a noun.
